executive_summary: This phased PR execution plan modernizes legacy-billing (Baseline Audit wf-8177454c: Grade C, 66/100) from a broken Java 1.8 / unpinned Spring Boot / cyclic monolith into a deterministic Java 21 LTS + Spring Boot 3.4.x + PostgreSQL 16 (JPA + Flyway) + Redis 7 service organized under Clean Architecture (domain / port / usecase / adapter). Phase 0 resolves the critical Spring Boot 4.2.0 vs Java 8 build crash and establishes JUnit 5 + MockMvc Golden Master tests preserving the strict POST /charge contract (customerId, amountCents, billedCents). Phase 1 severs the BillingController <-> BillingManager cycle and extracts framework-free Java 21 domain records and inbound/outbound Ports. Phase 2 executes OpenRewrite mechanical upgrades and introduces PostgreSQL/Redis/RestClient adapters. Phase 3 hardens inbound @Valid DTOs, removes hardcoded GATEWAY_SECRET, and resolves Stakeholder Decision Log quirks (currency == 'USD', fixed 100L retry, controllerPing). Phase 4 hardens Docker (multi-stage non-root eclipse-temurin:21-jre) and GitHub Actions CI before final PNI verification.
confirmed_assumptions: Target runtime & framework pinned to Java 21 LTS + Spring Boot 3.4.x BOM (Jakarta EE 10, JUnit 5 Jupiter, Mockito, JaCoCo).
Persistence externalized to PostgreSQL 16 via Spring Data JPA + Flyway versioned DDL migrations.
Process-local BillingManager.INVOICE_CACHE externalized to Redis 7 (StringRedisTemplate / Spring Data Redis) with explicit TTL.
Strict external HTTP JSON contract compatibility preserved on POST /charge (customerId, amountCents, billedCents).
Ambiguous legacy quirks (controllerPing key, String == comparisons, fixed 100L retry charge) isolated into Stakeholder Decision Log under ask_human policy prior to Phase 3.
non_goals: No microservice decomposition or multi-artifact repository split (retain single deployable Maven artifact).
No Kafka or RabbitMQ event bus introduction in this migration wave.
No breaking URL path changes or v2 API versioning on /charge.

target_axes.title: Java 1.8 -> Java 21 LTS & Legacy Date/Collection Cleanup
target_axes.as_is: pom.xml targets Java 1.8 (colliding with Java 11 java.net.http in GatewayClient and resolved Spring Boot 4.2.0 bytecode 61.0); LegacyDateHelper uses non-thread-safe SimpleDateFormat, java.util.Date, and Vector.
target_axes.to_be: Java 21 LTS toolchain with Maven Wrapper (mvnw), immutable Java 21 records, java.time.Instant/DateTimeFormatter, and List/ArrayList.
target_axes.migration_approach: Fix toolchain in Phase 0, run OpenRewrite UpgradeToJava21 recipe in Phase 2, and replace LegacyDateHelper with Clock/java.time in Wave 1.

target_axes.title: Unpinned Spring Boot / javax.servlet / JUnit 4 -> Spring Boot 3.4.x (Jakarta EE 10) + JUnit 5
target_axes.as_is: spring-boot-starter-web:LATEST without BOM, javax.servlet:4.0.1, JUnit 4.13.2 assertion-free test, @Autowired field injection, catch-all @RequestMapping, missing spring-tx.
target_axes.to_be: Pinned Spring Boot 3.4.x BOM, jakarta.servlet / jakarta.validation, Spring RestClient, constructor DI, @PostMapping('/charge'), JUnit 5 Jupiter + Mockito + JaCoCo.
target_axes.migration_approach: Pin Spring Boot 3.4.x BOM in Phase 0, apply OpenRewrite UpgradeSpringBoot_3_4 and JUnit4to5Migration in dedicated mechanical PRs during Phase 2.

target_axes.title: Cyclic Layered Monolith -> Clean Architecture (domain / port / usecase / adapter)
target_axes.as_is: Runtime circular dependency BillingController <-> BillingManager (via @Autowired circularController), cognitive=56 god method (8 params), raw Map/List payloads.
target_axes.to_be: Strict inward-only Clean Architecture: framework-free domain records & TaxPolicy, inbound/outbound Port interfaces, pure UseCase orchestrators, and isolated inbound/outbound Adapters.
target_axes.migration_approach: Follow topological Waves 1->4: migrate Wave 1 leaves to domain, sever BillingManager -> BillingController back-edge via explicit DTO inputs in Wave 3, then wrap adapters.

target_axes.title: Broken private @Transactional Stub -> PostgreSQL 16 + Spring Data JPA + Flyway
target_axes.as_is: BillingManager.saveAuditTrail() uses private @Transactional (bypassed by Spring AOP self-invocation and missing spring-tx) and prints to System.out.
target_axes.to_be: Outbound BillingAuditRepositoryPort implemented by JpaBillingAuditAdapter backed by PostgreSQL 16 and Flyway V1__create_billing_audit.sql.
target_axes.migration_approach: Extract BillingAuditRepositoryPort in Phase 1 (initially backed by an in-memory stub), then wire PostgreSQL JPA + Flyway adapter verified by Testcontainers in Phase 2.

target_axes.title: Static HashMap INVOICE_CACHE & Mutable Singleton Field -> Stateless + Redis 7 TTL
target_axes.as_is: Unsynchronized static raw Map BillingManager.INVOICE_CACHE and mutable singleton field BillingController.channel cause cross-request data races.
target_axes.to_be: Stateless controllers/usecases with InvoiceCachePort implemented by RedisInvoiceCacheAdapter (Redis 7 StringRedisTemplate with explicit TTL).
target_axes.migration_approach: Remove BillingController.channel in Wave 3 (passing HTTP method as a local parameter if controllerPing is retained) and move INVOICE_CACHE behind InvoiceCachePort -> Redis 7 in Phase 2.

target_axes.title: Hardcoded Secret, Unbounded HTTP Client & Unvalidated ANY /charge -> Hardened Boundary
target_axes.as_is: Hardcoded GATEWAY_SECRET in GatewayClient.java:13, System.getenv without typed config, unbounded HttpClient.newHttpClient(), unauthenticated ANY /charge with raw Map, unpinned CVE-2022-22965 range.
target_axes.to_be: @ConfigurationProperties secret & endpoint binding, timeout-bounded Spring RestClient adapter, @PostMapping('/charge') with @Valid ChargeRequest DTO, authentication filter, and SLF4J structured logging.
target_axes.migration_approach: Pin BOM in Phase 0 (clearing unpinned CVE range), replace GatewayClient with PaymentGatewayPort + RestClient in Phase 2, and enforce @Valid DTO + secret externalization in Phase 3.

target_axes.title: Broken openjdk:latest Root Dockerfile & Privileged CI -> Hardened Non-Root Temurin 21 + Pinned CI
target_axes.as_is: Dockerfile FROM openjdk:latest (removed on Docker Hub, runs as root, no .dockerignore, no HEALTHCHECK); .github/workflows/build.yml uses pull_request_target + actions/checkout@main without permissions.
target_axes.to_be: Multi-stage eclipse-temurin:21-jdk / eclipse-temurin:21-jre-alpine non-root image with .dockerignore and Actuator HEALTHCHECK; GitHub Actions pull_request workflow with contents: read and full commit-SHA pinning.
target_axes.migration_approach: Harden CI and multi-stage Dockerfile in Phase 4 (or immediately as an unblocking P0 PR alongside Phase 0 build fix), then re-run PNI full audit + Trivy + DAST.

target_architecture.pattern_name: Clean Architecture (Hexagonal / Ports & Adapters) on Java 21 + Spring Boot 3.4
target_architecture.summary: Four concentric rings with strict inward-only dependencies: pure Java 21 domain records/policies at the core, inbound/outbound Port interfaces, framework-free UseCase orchestrators, and swappable inbound web and outbound gateway/PostgreSQL/Redis adapters.
dependency_rules: domain MUST NOT import org.springframework.*, jakarta.persistence.*, java.net.http.*, or Redis libraries.
usecase depends ONLY on domain and port interfaces; never on adapter.in.* or adapter.out.*.
adapter.in.web translates strict external HTTP POST /charge JSON DTOs into domain commands and invokes inbound ports.
adapter.out.* implements outbound ports (PaymentGatewayPort, InvoiceCachePort, BillingAuditRepositoryPort) with explicit timeouts, TTLs, and @Transactional boundaries.

target_layers.responsibility: Pure Java 21 immutable record models (Invoice, Money, BillingSummary), Currency/InvoiceStatus enums, and deterministic TaxPolicy.
Inbound use-case contracts (ChargeCustomerUseCase, ProcessBatchBillingUseCase) and outbound SPI contracts (PaymentGatewayPort, InvoiceCachePort, BillingAuditRepositoryPort).
Pure billing orchestration services (ProcessBatchBillingService) coordinating tax calculation, bounded gateway retries, cache updates, and audit persistence without upward Controller references.
Stateless BillingController (@PostMapping('/charge')), @Valid ChargeRequest/ChargeResponse DTOs preserving strict external JSON keys, and exception mapping.

RestClientPaymentGatewayAdapter (connect/read timeouts + @ConfigurationProperties), JpaBillingAuditAdapter (PostgreSQL 16 + Flyway + public @Transactional), and RedisInvoiceCacheAdapter (Redis 7 with TTL).

component_mappings.refactoring_note: Wave 1 leaf: convert class to immutable Java 21 record with non-negative invariant validation.
Wave 1 leaf: replace SimpleDateFormat, java.util.Date, and synchronized Vector with thread-safe DateTimeFormatter, java.time.Clock, and List<String>.
Wave 2: externalize LEGACY_PAYMENT_URL & GATEWAY_SECRET into @ConfigurationProperties, enforce connect/read timeouts via Spring RestClient, and log via SLF4J.

Wave 3 cycle cut: sever @Autowired circularController, decompose cognitive=56 / 8-param method into BillingCommand + TaxPolicy, and delegate to PaymentGatewayPort, InvoiceCachePort, and BillingAuditRepositoryPort.
Replace unsynchronized static raw HashMap with Redis 7 StringRedisTemplate and explicit key TTL.
Replace ineffective private @Transactional System.out stub with PostgreSQL 16 Spring Data JPA repository + Flyway DDL and public @Transactional boundary.

Wave 3/4: remove mutable singleton 'channel' field, enforce @PostMapping('/charge') with @Valid ChargeRequest DTO, preserve strict JSON response keys (customerId, billedCents), and wire ChargeCustomerUseCase via constructor DI.
Wave 4: enable @ConfigurationPropertiesScan and Spring Boot Actuator health probes.

decision_log.current_behavior: Lines 52, 55, 57 compare status == "PAID", currency == "USD", and currency == "JPY" using Java reference equality (==), which works only for interned literals and silently skips tax/PAID checks for deserialized HTTP strings.
decision_log.impact_if_changed: Switching to .equals() / typed enums will cause non-interned 'USD'/'JPY' inputs to start incurring 8%/10% tax and 'PAID' invoices to be skipped — potentially changing billedCents for existing callers.
decision_log.recommended_option: Fix to typed Currency/InvoiceStatus enums (.equals()) in Phase 3 after verifying whether any caller relies on untaxed deserialized strings.
stakeholder_options: Option A (Recommended): Fix to .equals()/Enum in Phase 3 with explicit release note and characterization test update.
Option B: Preserve legacy reference-equality quirk behind a feature flag during rollout.

decision_log.current_behavior: When rec.getAmountCents() <= 0 and forceRetry is true, BillingManager loops up to maxRetries calling gatewayClient.sendCharge(customerId, 100L) and adds a hardcoded 100L cent fee.
decision_log.impact_if_changed: Changing or rejecting non-positive amounts alters retry fee revenue/ledger reconciliation for zero-amount invoice payloads.
decision_log.recommended_option: Confirm with billing product owners whether 100L is an intentional minimum authorization hold or a legacy bug before modifying in Phase 3.
stakeholder_options: Option A (Recommended): Keep 100L configurable via BillingProperties (default 100L) until business sign-off, then enforce @Positive validation if confirmed as bug.
Option B: Reject amountCents <= 0 with HTTP 400 immediately in Phase 3.

decision_log.current_behavior: When circularController != null && extraContext != null, response Map conditionally injects internal diagnostic key 'controllerPing' containing mutable BillingController.lastChannel().
decision_log.impact_if_changed: Dropping 'controllerPing' breaks any downstream monitoring script checking that diagnostic key, whereas keeping it requires passing request.getMethod() as a stateless parameter instead of a cyclic bean.
decision_log.recommended_option: Confirm whether any client reads 'controllerPing'; if needed under strict compatibility, pass HTTP method as a request-scoped parameter (zero shared state) and deprecate it.
stakeholder_options: Option A (Recommended): Pass request method as a stateless parameter when traceHint is present and deprecate 'controllerPing' via header.
Option B: Remove 'controllerPing' completely in Phase 3 after client audit confirms zero consumers.

decision_log.current_behavior: Empty catch (Exception e) {} silently swallows audit trail and cache failures, returning HTTP 200 even when persistence fails.
decision_log.impact_if_changed: Propagating persistence/cache exceptions will change failure responses from silent HTTP 200 to HTTP 500/503 unless graceful fallback is defined.
decision_log.recommended_option: Log all exceptions via SLF4J with correlation ID; fail-fast on PostgreSQL audit write errors while degrading gracefully (warn + metric) on Redis cache misses.
stakeholder_options: Option A (Recommended): Fail-fast on PostgreSQL audit failure + graceful warn fallback on Redis cache error.
Option B: Log via SLF4J while keeping best-effort HTTP 200 during Phase 2 shadow testing.

phase_gates.title: Phase 2 — OpenRewrite Codemods & PostgreSQL 16 / Redis 7 / RestClient Adapters
phase_gates.objective: Run deterministic OpenRewrite upgrades and swap temporary shims for production PostgreSQL 16 (JPA + Flyway), Redis 7 (TTL), and timeout-bounded Spring RestClient adapters.

migration_facts.resolved_brief:
Target Stack & Infrastructure (Confirmed):
  - Runtime & Framework: Java 21 LTS + Spring Boot 3.4.x BOM (Jakarta EE 10, JUnit 5 Jupiter, Mockito, JaCoCo)
  - Database & Persistence: PostgreSQL 16 via Spring Data JPA + Flyway versioned DDL migrations (replace ineffective @Transactional audit stub)
  - Cache & Session State: Redis 7 (Spring Data Redis / StringRedisTemplate) with explicit TTL (replace BillingManager.INVOICE_CACHE static raw Map and remove mutable BillingController.channel field)
  - Outbound HTTP Client: Spring RestClient / java.net.http.HttpClient with explicit connect/read timeouts and @ConfigurationProperties secret injection
  - Container & CI: Multi-stage eclipse-temurin:21-jdk / 21-jre-alpine non-root image with HEALTHCHECK; GitHub Actions pull_request trigger with pinned SHA actions
Target Design Philosophy:
  - Introduce Clean Architecture (`domain` / `usecase` / `port` / `adapter`):
    * `domain`: Pure Java 21 immutable `record` models (`Invoice`, `Money`, `BillingSummary`) and tax policy with zero Spring/JPA/Redis imports
    * `port`: Inbound `ChargeCustomerUseCase` / `ProcessBatchBillingUseCase` interfaces and outbound `PaymentGatewayPort`, `InvoiceCachePort`, `BillingAuditRepositoryPort`
    * `usecase`: Pure orchestration services implementing inbound ports without upward Controller dependencies
    * `adapter`: `adapter.in.web` (`BillingController` + `@Valid` request/response DTOs) and `adapter.out.{gateway,persistence,cache}`
Compatibility & Ambiguity Guardrails:
  - Strictly preserve external HTTP JSON contract on `POST /charge` (`customerId`, `amountCents`, `billedCents`); evaluate `controllerPing` diagnostic key, `currency == "USD"` reference comparison, and fixed `100L` retry charge via Stakeholder Decision Log before Phase 3 changes.
Confirmed Non-Goals:
  - No microservice split or Kafka/RabbitMQ event bus introduction in this migration wave (keep single deployable Maven artifact).

refactoring_waves.label: Wave 1: Leaf Models, Value Objects & Pure Utilities
refactoring_waves.rationale: Zero internal dependencies and zero external I/O; safe to migrate/type first as Domain core.

refactoring_waves.label: Wave 2: Outbound Infrastructure & Gateway/DB Clients
refactoring_waves.rationale: Depends only on Wave 1 leaves; prime candidates for Outbound Port & Adapter extraction.

refactoring_waves.label: Wave 3: Strongly Connected Components (Cycle Cut Targets)
refactoring_waves.rationale: Bidirectional circular dependencies that must be severed before layered/Clean Arch isolation.

refactoring_waves.label: Wave 4: Application Orchestrators, Controllers & Entrypoints
refactoring_waves.rationale: Top-level inbound adapters and boot entrypoints wired after Domain, Ports, and Adapters exist.

cycle_cuts.rationale: Break upward/cyclic back-reference `examples/java/api_spring_messy/src/main/java/com/example/billing/service/BillingManager.java -> examples/java/api_spring_messy/src/main/java/com/example/billing/controller/BillingController.java` by passing required scalar/DTO inputs explicitly or inverting dependency via a Port interface.
